items.note: The checks now state results ("One row shows 6 for all students and 4 for students with a city recorded"; "Each value is computed from the fee column of courses"), not functions. Hints ask the learner to decide which COUNT form or aggregate gives each figure. At work reads "two counts side by side in one query answer it". The learner must now choose COUNT(*) against COUNT(city), and SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX, unaided.
The worked examples no longer mirror the tasks. Activity 2 shows COUNT(grade) alone, with COUNT(*)'s result given in prose. Activity 3 shows only AVG and MAX, with SUM and MIN described in words.
